verses.literal: [This is] a prayer of Habakkuk the prophet according to Shigionoth

verses.original: יְהוָ֗ה שָׁמַ֣עְתִּי שִׁמְעֲךָ֮ יָרֵאתִי֒ יְהוָ֗ה פָּֽעָלְךָ֙ חַיֵּ֔יהוּ בְּקֶ֤רֶב שָׁנִים֙ תּוֹדִ֑יעַ בְּקֶ֥רֶב שָׁנִ֖ים בְּרֹ֖גֶז תִּזְכּֽוֹר׃ רַחֵ֥ם
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh šā·ma‘·tî šim·‘ă·ḵā yā·rê·ṯî Yah·weh pā·‘ā·lə·ḵā ḥay·yê·hū bə·qe·reḇ šā·nîm tō·w·ḏî·a‘ bə·qe·reḇ šā·nîm bə·rō·ḡez tiz·kō·wr ra·ḥêm
verses.literal: O LORD I have heard the report of You I stand in awe O LORD of Your deeds Revive them in these years make them known in these years In Your wrath remember mercy

verses.original: אֱל֙וֹהַ֙ יָב֔וֹא מִתֵּימָ֣ן וְקָד֥וֹשׁ מֵֽהַר־ פָּארָ֖ן סֶ֑לָה הוֹד֔וֹ כִּסָּ֤ה שָׁמַ֙יִם֙ וּתְהִלָּת֖וֹ מָלְאָ֥ה הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: ʾɛ̆·lō·ha yā·ḇō·w mit·tê·mān wə·qā·ḏō·wōš mê·har- pā·rān se·lāh hō·w·ḏōw kis·sāh šā·ma·yim ū·ṯə·hil·lā·ṯōw mā·lə·’āh hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: God came from Teman and the Holy One from Mount Paran Selah His glory covered the heavens and His praise filled the earth

verses.original: וְנֹ֙גַהּ֙ תִּֽהְיֶ֔ה כָּא֣וֹר קַרְנַ֥יִם מִיָּד֖וֹ ל֑וֹ וְשָׁ֖ם עֻזֹּֽה׃ חֶבְי֥וֹן
verses.transliteration: wə·nō·ḡah tih·yeh kā·’ō·wr qar·na·yim mî·yā·ḏōw lōw wə·šām ʿuz·zōh ḥeḇ·yō·wn
verses.literal: [His] radiance was like the sunlight rays [flashed] from His hand where His power is hidden

verses.original: דָּ֑בֶר יֵ֣לֶךְ לְפָנָ֖יו רֶ֖שֶׁף וְיֵצֵ֥א לְרַגְלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: dā·ḇer yê·leḵ lə·p̄ā·nāw re·šep̄ wə·yê·ṣê lə·raḡ·lāw
verses.literal: Plague went before Him and fever followed in His steps

verses.original: עָמַ֣ד׀ וַיְמֹ֣דֶד אֶ֗רֶץ רָאָה֙ וַיַּתֵּ֣ר גּוֹיִ֔ם עַ֔ד הַרְרֵי־ וַיִּתְפֹּֽצְצוּ֙ עוֹלָ֑ם גִּבְע֣וֹת שַׁח֖וּ לֽוֹ׃ הֲלִיכ֥וֹת עוֹלָ֖ם
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·maḏ way·mō·ḏeḏ ’e·reṣ rā·’āh way·yat·têr gō·w·yim ‘aḏ har·rê- way·yiṯ·pō·ṣə·ṣū ‘ō·w·lām giḇ·‘ō·wṯ ša·ḥū lōw hă·lî·ḵō·wṯ ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: He stood and measured the earth He looked and startled the nations the ancient mountains crumbled the perpetual hills collapsed His ways [are] everlasting

verses.original: רָאִ֖יתִי אָהֳלֵ֣י כוּשָׁ֑ן תַּ֣חַת אָ֔וֶן יְרִיע֖וֹת אֶ֥רֶץ מִדְיָֽן׃ס יִרְגְּז֕וּן
verses.transliteration: rā·’î·ṯî ’ā·ho·lê ḵū·šān ta·ḥaṯ ’ā·wen yə·rî·‘ō·wṯ ’e·reṣ miḏ·yān yir·gə·zūn
verses.literal: I saw the tents of Cushan in distress the curtains vvv of Midian were trembling

verses.original: חָרָ֣ה הֲבִנְהָרִים֙ יְהוָ֔ה אִ֤ם אַפֶּ֔ךָ אִם־ בַּנְּהָרִים֙ עֶבְרָתֶ֑ךָ בַּיָּ֖ם כִּ֤י תִרְכַּב֙ עַל־ סוּסֶ֔יךָ מַרְכְּבֹתֶ֖יךָ יְשׁוּעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ḥā·rāh hă·ḇin·hā·rîm Yah·weh ’im ’ap·pe·ḵā ’im- ban·nə·hā·rîm ‘eḇ·rā·ṯe·ḵā bay·yām kî ṯir·kaḇ ‘al- sū·se·ḵā mar·kə·ḇō·ṯe·ḵā yə·šū·‘āh
verses.literal: Were You angry at the rivers O LORD Was Your wrath . . . against the streams Did You rage against the sea when You rode on Your horses on Your chariots of salvation

verses.original: עֶרְיָ֤ה תֵעוֹר֙ קַשְׁתֶּ֔ךָ אֹ֣מֶר שְׁבֻע֥וֹת מַטּ֖וֹת סֶ֑לָה תְּבַקַּע־ אָֽרֶץ׃ נְהָר֖וֹת
verses.transliteration: ‘er·yāh ṯê·‘ō·wr qaš·te·ḵā ’ō·mer šə·ḇu·‘ō·wṯ maṭ·ṭō·wṯ se·lāh tə·ḇaq·qa‘- ’ā·reṣ nə·hā·rō·wṯ
verses.literal: You brandished . . . Your bow You called for . . . many arrows Selah You split the earth with rivers

verses.original: הָרִ֔ים רָא֤וּךָ יָחִ֙ילוּ֙ זֶ֥רֶם מַ֖יִם עָבָ֑ר תְּהוֹם֙ נָתַ֤ן קוֹל֔וֹ נָשָֽׂא׃ יָדֵ֥יהוּ ר֖וֹם
verses.transliteration: hā·rîm rā·’ū·ḵā yā·ḥî·lū ze·rem ma·yim ‘ā·ḇār tə·hō·wm nā·ṯan qō·w·lōw nā·śā yā·ḏê·hū rō·wm
verses.literal: The mountains saw You [and] quaked torrents of water swept by The deep roared with its voice and lifted its hands on high

verses.original: שֶׁ֥מֶשׁ יָרֵ֖חַ עָ֣מַד זְבֻ֑לָה לְא֤וֹר יְהַלֵּ֔כוּ חִצֶּ֙יךָ֙ לְנֹ֖גַהּ בְּרַ֥ק חֲנִיתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: še·meš yā·rê·aḥ ‘ā·maḏ zə·ḇu·lāh lə·’ō·wr yə·hal·lê·ḵū ḥiṣ·ṣe·ḵā lə·nō·ḡah bə·raq ḥă·nî·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: Sun and moon stood still in their places at the flash of Your flying arrows at the brightness of Your shining spear

verses.original: תִּצְעַד־ אָ֑רֶץ בְּזַ֖עַם תָּד֥וּשׁ גּוֹיִֽם׃ בְּאַ֖ף
verses.literal: You marched across the earth with fury You threshed the nations in wrath

verses.original: יָצָ֙אתָ֙ לְיֵ֣שַׁע עַמֶּ֔ךָ לְיֵ֖שַׁע אֶת־ מְשִׁיחֶ֑ךָ מָחַ֤צְתָּ רֹּאשׁ֙ מִבֵּ֣ית רָשָׁ֔ע עָר֛וֹת צַוָּ֖אר עַד־ יְס֥וֹד סֶֽלָה׃פ
verses.transliteration: yā·ṣā·ṯā lə·yê·ša‘ ‘am·me·ḵā lə·yê·ša‘ ’eṯ- mə·šî·ḥe·ḵā mā·ḥaṣ·tā rōš mib·bêṯ rā·šā‘ ‘ā·rō·wṯ ṣaw·wār ‘aḏ- yə·sō·wḏ se·lāh
verses.literal: You went forth for the salvation of Your people to save - Your anointed You crushed the head of the house of the wicked and stripped him from head to toe Selah

verses.original: בְמַטָּיו֙ נָקַ֤בְתָּ רֹ֣אשׁ פְּרָזוֹ יִסְעֲר֖וּ לַהֲפִיצֵ֑נִי עֲלִ֣יצֻתָ֔ם כְּמוֹ־ בַּמִּסְתָּֽר׃ לֶאֱכֹ֥ל עָנִ֖י
verses.transliteration: ḇə·maṭ·ṭāw nā·qaḇ·tā rōš pə·rå̄·zō yis·‘ă·rū la·hă·p̄î·ṣê·nî ‘ă·lî·ṣu·ṯām kə·mōw- bam·mis·tār le·’ĕ·ḵōl ‘ā·nî
verses.literal: With his own spear You pierced his head when his warriors stormed out to scatter us gloating as though ready to secretly devour the weak

verses.original: דָּרַ֥כְתָּ בַיָּ֖ם סוּסֶ֑יךָ חֹ֖מֶר רַבִּֽים׃ מַ֥יִם
verses.transliteration: dā·raḵ·tā ḇay·yām sū·se·ḵā ḥō·mer rab·bîm ma·yim
verses.literal: You trampled the sea with Your horses churning the great waters

verses.original: שָׁמַ֣עְתִּי׀ וַתִּרְגַּ֣ז בִּטְנִ֗י שְׂפָתַ֔י צָלֲל֣וּ לְקוֹל֙ רָקָ֛ב יָב֥וֹא בַּעֲצָמַ֖י אֶרְגָּ֑ז אֲשֶׁ֤ר וְתַחְתַּ֣י אָנ֙וּחַ֙ לְי֣וֹם צָרָ֔ה לַעֲל֖וֹת לְעַ֥ם יְגוּדֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: šā·ma‘·tî wat·tir·gaz biṭ·nî śə·p̄ā·ṯay ṣā·lă·lū lə·qō·wl rā·qāḇ yā·ḇō·w ba·‘ă·ṣā·may ’er·gāz ’ă·šer wə·ṯaḥ·tay ’ā·nū·aḥ lə·yō·wm ṣā·rāh la·‘ă·lō·wṯ lə·‘am yə·ḡū·ḏen·nū
verses.literal: I heard and trembled within my lips quivered at the sound Decay entered my bones I trembled - where I stood Yet I must wait patiently for the day of distress to come upon the people who invade us

verses.original: כִּֽי־ תְאֵנָ֣ה לֹֽא־ תִפְרָ֗ח וְאֵ֤ין יְבוּל֙ בַּגְּפָנִ֔ים זַ֔יִת מַעֲשֵׂה־ כִּחֵשׁ֙ וּשְׁדֵמ֖וֹת עָ֣שָׂה לֹא־ אֹ֑כֶל צֹ֔אן גָּזַ֤ר מִמִּכְלָה֙ וְאֵ֥ין בָּקָ֖ר בָּרְפָתִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ṯə·’ê·nāh lō- ṯip̄·rāḥ wə·’ên yə·ḇūl bag·gə·p̄ā·nîm za·yiṯ ma·‘ă·śêh- ki·ḥêš ū·šə·ḏê·mō·wṯ ‘ā·śāh lō- ’ō·ḵel ṣōn gā·zar mim·miḵ·lāh wə·’ên bā·qār bā·rə·p̄ā·ṯîm
verses.literal: Though the fig tree does not bud and no fruit [is] on the vines though the olive crop fails and the fields produce no food though the sheep are cut off from the fold and no cattle [are] in the stalls

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֖י אֶעְל֑וֹזָה בַּיהוָ֣ה אָגִ֖ילָה בֵּאלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׁעִֽי׃
verses.literal: yet I will exult in the LORD I will rejoice in the God of my salvation

verses.original: יְהוִ֤הּ אֲדֹנָי֙ חֵילִ֔י וַיָּ֤שֶׂם רַגְלַי֙ כָּֽאַיָּל֔וֹת יַדְרִכֵ֑נִי וְעַ֥ל בָּמוֹתַ֖י לַמְנַצֵּ֖חַ בִּנְגִינוֹתָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ha·šēm ’ă·ḏō·nāy ḥê·lî way·yā·śem raḡ·lay kā·’ay·yā·lō·wṯ yaḏ·ri·ḵê·nî wə·‘al bā·mō·w·ṯay lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ bin·ḡî·nō·w·ṯāy
verses.literal: GOD the Lord is my strength He makes my feet like those of a deer He makes me walk upon the heights For the choirmaster With stringed instruments
